derivation: from H4480 (מִן) and H3225 (יָמִין); from (the) right hand;
def: Minjamin, the name of two Israelites

occurrences.text: And next him were Eden, and Miniamin, and Jeshua, and Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in their set office, to give to their brethren by courses, as well to the great as to the small:
Of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai;
And the priests; Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Michaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;
